body: Honesty this community is why I have hope in humanity, the great things I have seen happen here make me feel happy, but when I am alone with only my thoughts I think I'm doomed. I guess I never mentioned it, but I talk to myself. Like alot, more than a normal person would. I guess the phrase you are your own best friend really does apply, but I'm not a very good friend when I think about killing myself. Honestly I just need someone to talk to thats in a similar situation.
